gpu_benchmark_info.image: 1080 x 1920 RGBA, independent uniform [0, 1) samples (torch.Generator seed 0)
gpu_benchmark_info.kernels: sampled 2c/4c/6c complex-Gaussian disc families (ranks 4/8/12) as orthogonal rowSpan channels with unit DC gain; direct and cuFFT use the dense rank-4 kernel
gpu_benchmark_info.errors: err_max_* and err_rms_* are absolute errors of each method's output against a float64 separable convolution with the same border rule (replicate, or zero for cufft_zero); float16 errors include rounding the input image to float16
gpu_benchmark_info.timing: mean and standard deviation in ms over 10 CUDA-Event batches (15 calls each; direct: 2 to 5); launch parameters (config_*) are tuned by timing at start-up, and means differed by up to 6% between two complete runs, more than the within-run standard deviations
gpu_benchmark_info.direct: Triton dense W x W convolution, several output rows per program sharing each row load
gpu_benchmark_info.cufft: channel pairs packed as complex planes, in-place complex FFT, real even-kernel spectrum; 7-smooth period chosen by timing; zero padding (period >= size + L) or replicate padding (period >= size + 2L)
gpu_benchmark_info.sep: Triton vertical fan-out and horizontal fan-in passes with register sliding windows over L2-resident strips (float32, or float16 input, intermediates and output with float32 accumulation)
